blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—While Reinhard Jumamoy is arguably National University’s top guard, the Bulldogs showed they have more than one capable playmaker in their arsenal with the emergence of Tebol Garcia. Garcia played the role of leader for NU’s bench mob in the 79-43 rout of Adamson on Saturday in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Blue Eagle Gym. “I huddled the second group and told them, whatever the starters will do, we have to do better,” Garcia said in Filipino. “Coach Jeff (Napa) always tells me to stay composed and facilitate […]...
